decision.reason: [ev-cbd1809faa20] says the max labels-per-series limit went from 30 to 15, which covers the change. It doesn't name the configuration key that sets the limit, so the subject is open and the applicability condition can't be written. It also doesn't say what happens to series with more than 15 labels (for example, whether pushes are rejected), so the consequence is open. For these details the excerpt only points to the separate "Changes to default configuration values in 3.0" section, and that section isn't among the cited evidence. It is needed to settle the open aspects.
